summary:
Your overall health metrics show a steady state over the first quarter of 2025, with some notable improvements. Your weight has remained relatively stable, with a slight increase from 84.1 kg to 84.3 kg, which may be worth noting. Your resting heart rate has improved, dropping from 64.0 beats per minute to 61.7 beats per minute, indicating better recovery and fitness. Heart rate variability (SDNN) has also improved, increasing from 31.2 milliseconds to 34.3 milliseconds, suggesting better recovery and lower stress levels.

Steps taken have decreased from an average of 7,417 per week to 6,698, which might be slightly lower than the recommended daily step count. However, maintaining a regular exercise routine is important, and your average exercise time of 26.0 minutes per day is in line with the World Health Organization's recommendation. VO₂ max has shown a minor improvement, staying within a consistent range. Sleep duration has been fairly stable, averaging 7.3 hours per night, which aligns well with the recommended 7–9 hours.

Overall, the trends suggest that you are maintaining a healthy lifestyle, with improvements in key areas like heart rate and heart rate variability. To further enhance your wellbeing, consider increasing your daily step count and maintaining a consistent exercise routine.
